scope: Independent supplementary source inventory of current named ASCII x closes missed by the original explicit Unicode/entity scanner. No application/ledger edits or runtime claims.

entries.migration: Use existing local close SVG while preserving all original button attributes and accessible name. Where main delegate uses event.target.matches, add reviewed narrowly scoped decorative child pointer handling or prove a separate preserved delegation change.
entries.runtime_gate: Open actual context through its existing native launcher, assert name/optical box/actual pointer and tap over SVG, close correct modal, restore opener, and preserve dirty/pending/confirmation guards and no close-request.
